Definition: from G3844 and G5177; to chance near, i.e. fall in with:--meet with.
BiblicalUsage: Paratynchano means to chance upon, to meet with. It appears once, in Acts 17:17, where Paul disputes in the synagogue with the Jews and in the market daily with those who meet with him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Paul preached to whoever happened by, and the market place was as much a pulpit as the synagogue.
